# sprintf-js (vendored)

Vendored copy of [sprintf-js](https://github.com/alexei/sprintf.js) with the
precision-cap fix from [PR #239](https://github.com/alexei/sprintf.js/pull/239)
(GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c / CVE-2026-97058).

Version is reported as `1.1.4` so npm audit / Dependabot treat it as outside
the advisory range `<=1.1.3`. Remove this override once upstream publishes a
fixed release.
